scope: non-Mundarica peer-reviewed article exact bibliographic/abstract locator with participant-derived media boundary

source.title: Expressives and the multimodal depiction of social types in Mundari
source.author: Nishaant Choksi

identity_and_metadata_verification.dedup_decision: Use DOI as canonical identity key; any publisher share/read-only pages, indexes, mirrors or citations must alias to the DOI identity rather than form new source identities.

exact_locator_evidence.reason: Publisher metadata, abstract and footnote are directly accessible and exact-locatable; full article text and underlying participant-derived recordings are not treated as openly ingestible evidence.

participant_and_cultural_boundary.promotion_rule: Do not ingest or expose underlying interview/video content, participant-derived examples, identities beyond already-public bibliographic acknowledgements, or culturally sensitive material without separate rights, consent, community and cultural-access review.

synchronization_decision.coverage_or_gap_change: scholarly exact-locator coverage strengthened; participant-derived audiovisual content remains explicitly gated

promotion_boundary: Promote the DOI-resolved bibliographic record and directly observable publisher abstract/footnote metadata only. Do not promote internal article passages or underlying video/interview claims until lawful full-text acquisition and participant/community/cultural-access review support them.
